test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

These days most of the researchers conduct research with the help of internet.

options.text: These days most of the research is being done with the help of internet.
These days the research has been done with the help of internet by most of the researchers.
These days most of the researchers are conducting their research with the help of internet.
These days the research is conducted with the help of internet by most of the researchers.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "These days most of the researchers conduct research with the help of internet."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "research" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "conduct" to "is conducted" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "most of the researchers."
 
• Ensure the phrase "these days" remains at the beginning of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"These days the research is conducted with the help of internet by most of the researchers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"These days most of the research is being done with the help of internet." – Incorrect use of present continuous passive.
 
• **Option 2: **"These days the research has been done with the help of internet by most of the researchers." – Incorrect use of present perfect passive.
 
• **Option 3: **"These days most of the researchers are conducting their research with the help of internet." – This is still in active voice.

``
